verdict.rationale: Codex cloud documents running tasks in parallel in isolated cloud environments, delegating longer tasks and returning when they are ready, and starting work from GitHub, GitLab, Linear or Slack. The CLI adds subagents for focused work and `codex cloud` for submitting and browsing tasks, which covers the core of launching parallel autonomous agents. The docs never state how long tasks can run or how many can run at once, so the 'fleets' and 'hours or days' parts of the story go unevidenced. One community comment says the model struggles to call agents, which is a caveat but not a concrete failure. Missing for 10: documented support for multi-hour or multi-day runs, stated limits on fleet size or concurrency, and independent hands-on corroboration of long-running parallel work.
